name: abstract-dont-copy
description: Find the mechanism behind a bug before fixing it: reproduce it, name the cause without naming the instance, find every other place it left a hole, fix at the level that closes the whole class, and add a guard shown to fail before the fix.

interface.shortDescription: Fix the mechanism, not just the hole.
